from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class PaperCitationInfo(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single paper regarding its citation relationships within the provided collection."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers (from the collection) that appear in this paper's reference list")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt from the bibliography or text confirming the reference")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregated citation information for all provided papers."""
    papers: list[PaperCitationInfo]
